subject: hm-learn-content
description: Reading hm-learn-content documents (docs/formats/hm-learn-content.md). input.document is the document, as a JSON value or as JSON text; input.limits, when given, overrides learn-sdk's default limits. expected is the content as the reader returns it, or the rejection. The host registers the built-in types and "free-form", whose payload is any object, returned unchanged.

cases.name: reads one exercise of each built-in type
reads a document with no exercises
reads a document from JSON text

input.document: {"format":"hm-learn-content","version":1,"exercises":[{"id":"mc","type":"multiple-choice","title":"อาหาร","payload":{"questions":[{"prompt":"กิน","choices":["eat","drink","sleep"],"correct":0,"explanation":"กิน means to eat."}]}},{"id":"gf","type":"gap-fill","payload":{"items":[{"sentence":"ฉัน ___ ข้าว","answers":["กิน"],"options":["กิน","ดื่ม"],"translation":"I eat rice."},{"sentence":"Je _____ du pain.","answers":["mange"]}]}},{"id":"wo","type":"word-order","instructions":"Put the words in order.","payload":{"items":[{"tiles":["Yesterday","I","ran"],"alternatives":[["I","ran","Yesterday"]]}]}}]}
